title: Tetragonal ZrO2 supported low-iridium catalyst activating oxygen spillover stabilized lattice oxygen for proton exchange membrane water electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5470-5481
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00544B, Paper
Song Ru Fang, Hai Xiang Yang, Hao Yang Lin, Miao Yu Lin, Fang Xin Mao, Hao Fan, Huai Qin Fu, Hai Yang Yuan, Chenghua Sun, Peng Fei Liu, Hua Gui Yang
A tetragonal ZrO2 supported IrOx oxygen-evolving catalyst was constructed which induced an oxygen spillover stabilized lattice oxygen oxidation pathway for enhancing the activity and durability towards proton exchange membrane water electrolysis.
